title: Backlog grooming, 1.5.0 through 1.6.0
pointNote: 1 point is about half a day for one engineer, tests included; 78 points a sprint is roughly five engineers, the 1.4.0 pace. 1.5.0 runs Sprints 29 to 34 as Backlog-1.5.0.md has it after the 2026-10-05 merges (B-37, B-38, B-39 Workflows 2, B-40, B-41); 1.6.0 is Sprints 35 to 37.

releases.note: Sprint 29 in progress (B-3401 done). Sprints 30 and 31 are over the guide in the written plan (107 and 94); 32 to 34 hold Workflows 2, chat invocation and chaining.
New; three sprints at the same pace.

items.title: Permission matrices and custom roles
items.description: Role × permission matrix, custom roles per tenant, effective-access matrix with explain, route permission registry, access reviews (B-3301 to B-3305). Being built on sprint-29a.
items.doneWhen: A tenant admin cannot create a role holding platform:manage; every cell's explain matches policy.explain.

items.title: Prototype boards for the eleven 1.4.0 domains
items.description: Done on sprint-29.
items.doneWhen: Every new board passes the smoke run in light and dark.

items.title: Live screens: Certificates, Vault, Plugins, Apps, Files, identity additions
items.description: B-3402, B-3403, B-3404, B-3407 (13), B-3408, B-3413: the Sprint 29 half of the B-34 screens, waiting on 29a's server items.
items.doneWhen: Issuing a certificate, a policy explain, revoking a grant, an entity accepting a record and a shared link all work from the screens.

items.title: Low-code record queries from an index on PostgreSQL
items.description: NULLS LAST, collate C indexes on app_record_values, one indexed field first, keyset paging. Being built on sprint-29b.
items.doneWhen: The 1.4.0 load test's records query p95 is below 250 ms on PostgreSQL.

items.title: Live screens: Moderation, Groups, Channels, Messages and feed, Roles, accessibility
items.doneWhen: Upholding an appeal restores the object; every new screen passes axe and reflow.

items.title: CalDAV and CardDAV over events and the directory
items.description: WebDAV core with sync-collection and app passwords, CalDAV with RSVP write-back, CardDAV read-only directory, a recorded conformance run (B-3101 to B-3104). App passwords decided: allowed with an MFA step-up and a DAV-only scope.
items.doneWhen: An RSVP from Apple Calendar shows in the attendee list; a contact above the caller's clearance is not returned.

items.title: WebDAV for the file store
items.description: Folders and files as collections through quarantine, COPY, MOVE, LOCK, quota properties, litmus in CI (B-3201 to B-3203). The backlog names it the second thing to move if capacity is short.
items.doneWhen: litmus passes basic, copymove and locks; an upload over WebDAV is scanned before it can be read.

items.title: Model-based memory management
items.description: B-3701 to B-3703 (PR #38): memory extraction with a model hook instead of rules only, review and consolidation.
items.doneWhen: An extracted memory names the profile that wrote it and can be rejected before it is used.

items.title: Import wizard: repository registry, catalogue browse, model import
items.description: B-3801 (8), B-3802 (5), B-3803 (8) (PR #39): registries with vault credentials, facets and snapshots, model import with gate acceptance, pickle checks, licence policy (legal-review role) and GGUF conversion.
items.doneWhen: A model imported from a Hugging Face compatible hub is a draft catalogue entry with its licence recorded.

items.title: Merge MongoDB data connections
items.description: feat/mongodb-connections (9006b55, 3 commits, behind main): read-only find and aggregate, collection knowledge sources. Rebase, test on the three databases, merge; then the sample-mongodb connection script can run. Numbered under B-36 (carried over).
items.doneWhen: The sample-mongodb connection registers on :8091 and its knowledge base builds.

items.title: Import wizard: dataset import, knowledge sets, eval sets, the Import screen
items.description: B-3804 (8), B-3805 (8), B-3806 (5), B-3807 (8): datasets with PII flags and scrub under the 500 GB tenant import quota, knowledge sets from datasets, classifier eval sets, the live #/import screen. The backlog names it the third thing to move.
items.doneWhen: A CKAN dataset becomes a knowledge base with citations back to the publisher.

items.title: AT-Protocol personal data server
items.description: Accounts on Exprsn-AI identities, the repository (MST, signed commits, CAR), blobs through quarantine, outbound subscribeRepos, migration and takedowns, interop against the reference PDS (B-2901 to B-2906). Decided: opt-in per tenant on a platform subdomain. The backlog names P2 the first thing to move to 1.6.
items.doneWhen: A post written to Exprsn-AI's PDS appears in the reference AppView.

items.title: Custom feed generator
items.description: describeFeedGenerator and getFeedSkeleton with service JWT verification, feed rules over the firehose index, a feed index with cursors, publishing the generator record (B-3001 to B-3004).
items.doneWhen: A post from an author outside the rule never appears in the feed.

items.title: Live screen: AT-Protocol
items.description: Service DIDs and keys, the labeler and trusted labelers, firehose subscriptions; the PDS and feed generator tabs follow B-29 and B-30.
items.doneWhen: Rotating a key from the screen updates the DID document.

items.title: Workflows 2: sub-workflows, agent steps, triggers, domain steps, map and loop, failures, bundles
items.description: B-3901 to B-3910, added 2026-10-05 from the Sprint 29 prototype roll-up and approved by the owner: sub-workflow and agent steps, event and schedule triggers, built-in domain tools, map and loop, retry and failure edges, approval forms, notify and webhook steps, signed bundles, the live Workflows screen.
items.doneWhen: A published workflow runs a child workflow and an agent step within their budgets, and a failed step lands in the dead-letter view.

items.title: Settings: app passwords for DAV clients
items.description: DAV-only scope, device names, last use, revoke; the decided MFA step-up on creation.
items.doneWhen: An app password never opens the API or the console.

items.title: The chain context
items.description: Every invocation (chat turn, agent run, workflow run, tool call, skill load) carries a chain id, depth, budgets and label; the first item of B-41, placed with Workflows 2.
items.doneWhen: A tool call started from a workflow started from chat shows the whole chain in its audit entry.

items.title: Agents, tools and skills in chat
items.description: B-4001 to B-4008, added 2026-10-05 at the owner's request: capabilities per conversation, /tool with forms and approvals, @agent runs bound to the conversation, +skill, model hand-off to agents, the Chat board and live screen.
items.doneWhen: A destructive tool proposed by the model waits for the in-chat approval and the run shows in the conversation.

items.title: Chaining agents, skills, tools and workflows
items.description: B-4102 to B-4109: agents delegating to agents, composing skills, workflows as callees, chain checks at publish, approvals and failures through the chain, the chain view in Runs, boards and the live screen.
items.doneWhen: A chain held at its third level is approved once and finishes; a cycle is refused at publish.

items.title: Release 1.5.0
items.description: Version, CHANGELOG, api.md, permissions.md, accessibility.md and the known-gaps sections.

items.title: Platform administration live screens: Overview, Jobs, Storage, Configuration, Social
items.description: B-4202 to B-4207 (PR #42): the five admin screens made live, with their routes, the settings descriptor with database overrides under dual control (Q2) and the integrity job. The boards (B-4201) are done. Decision Q12 in design/platform-admin; 1.5.0 has no room at the 78-point pace.
items.doneWhen: Draining an instance, pausing a job type, deleting an orphan after a dry run and revoking a calendar feed all work from the screens.

items.group: New: platform features without a plan
items.title: Live streaming: ingest, rooms, simulcast, recordings
items.description: The platform's Live module: RTMP or WHIP ingest through SRS, WebRTC rooms and calls from chat, simulcast to YouTube and Twitch, recordings through moderation, the room collaboration API. Needs SRS or Cloudflare Stream plus TURN; the largest platform module without a home.
items.doneWhen: A stream started from a group is watched by two members and its recording appears in Files after the scan.

items.group: New: platform features without a plan
items.title: Governance: proposals and voting
items.description: Proposals in a group with for, against and abstain, tallies, centralised or consensus models, execute and close by owners. Deferred in 1.5.0 for lack of demand.
items.doneWhen: A proposal closes with its tally in the audit chain.

items.group: New: platform features without a plan
items.title: End-to-end-encrypted messaging
items.description: The platform's Spark encrypted conversations and encryption gate. Conflicts with server-side guardrails, summaries and semantic search; a per-conversation opt-out of every AI feature would be the price.
items.doneWhen: A message the server cannot read is delivered and never summarised.

items.group: New: platform features without a plan
items.title: Groups depth: subgroups and channels, discovery, location, trending, categories
items.description: Subgroups or channels inside a group (8), recommendations and a discovery page (5), an optional location on groups and events with distance filters (5), trending groups by job (3). Exprsn-AI groups are flat today. Plus a tenant-managed category list (3, decision Q6).
items.doneWhen: A channel inside a group has its own members and feed; the discovery page never shows a group above the viewer's clearance.

items.group: New: platform features without a plan
items.title: User profiles: avatar, bio, profile page
items.description: Avatar through the file store and quarantine, bio and pronouns with the user-input guardrail, a profile page the feed, messaging and groups open, visibility by workspace. Users have a display name only today.
items.doneWhen: Opening an author from a post shows their profile; an avatar that fails the scan is never shown.

items.group: New: platform features without a plan
items.title: Presence status: available, away, busy, offline
items.description: A chosen or idle-derived status over the existing presence sockets, shown in messaging and the directory; blocked users see nothing.
items.doneWhen: A member set to busy shows busy to a contact within five seconds and not at all to a blocked user.

items.group: New: platform features without a plan
items.title: Quote posts and per-post visibility
items.description: Quote a post with a comment (the platform's quotes), and public, workspace or unlisted visibility per post alongside its label.
items.doneWhen: An unlisted post is reachable by link and absent from every feed.

items.group: New: platform features without a plan
items.title: Recurring events and VTIMEZONE in calendar feeds
items.description: RRULE recurrence with exceptions on events, reminders per occurrence, VTIMEZONE in the signed feeds and over CalDAV. Noted as a gap at the 1.4.0 release.
items.doneWhen: A weekly event with one cancelled occurrence round-trips through Apple Calendar.

items.group: New: platform features without a plan
items.title: Blob deduplication by content hash
items.description: Reference-counted blobs so identical uploads share storage, within a tenant's sealed-key boundary only; the Storage screen shows savings.
items.doneWhen: Two uploads of one file in a tenant occupy one blob; deleting one leaves the other readable.

items.group: New: platform features without a plan
items.title: Vault extras: secret sharing, MongoDB leases, access anomalies
items.description: Share a KV secret with a principal under the path policies (3), a MongoDB engine for dynamic credentials (5), anomaly detection on reveals (new address, odd hour, burst) raising a flag (8). The platform's Vault had all three.
items.doneWhen: A burst of reveals from a new address raises a flag before the tenth reveal.

items.group: New: platform features without a plan
items.title: Capability tokens: resource-scoped, use-limited
items.description: One mechanism for the platform's CA tokens: a token bound to a URL, DID or content id with a permission set, time or use expiry, issued and revoked from Settings and Identity; share links and scoped API keys become cases of it.
items.doneWhen: A token with max uses 3 is refused on its fourth use and the refusal is audited.

items.group: New: platform features without a plan
items.title: Web push notifications
items.description: VAPID web push for the in-app notifications, per-device subscriptions revoked with sessions, never carrying content above the device's label.
items.doneWhen: A flag escalation reaches a subscribed browser with the session closed.

items.group: New: platform features without a plan
items.title: SMS one-time codes
items.description: An SMS factor through a paid provider, same lockout as email codes. Deferred in 1.5.0 for the provider.
items.doneWhen: A sixth wrong code locks like a wrong TOTP.

items.group: New: platform features without a plan
items.title: Tenant provisioning templates
items.description: Create a tenant from a template (workspaces, roles, profiles, a zone, an issuer) from the Tenants screen and the CLI; the platform's enterprise, team and personal types. Decision Q11.
items.doneWhen: A tenant created from the team template signs in with its first admin in one step.

items.group: New: platform features without a plan
items.title: Server log view in the console
items.description: The last lines per instance, redacted, platform:manage. Decision Q7 defaults to none: traces and metrics are exported, logs stay on the host.
items.doneWhen: A tenant's message text never appears in the view.

items.title: RSVP capacity race
items.description: Two simultaneous RSVPs can both take the last place (B-2502). A row lock or a conditional update on the capacity.
items.doneWhen: Fifty concurrent RSVPs for one place leave one attendee on all three databases.

items.title: Verify relay commit signatures on the firehose
items.description: subscribeRepos commits are not signature-verified (B-1908); verify against the repo's DID key and drop and audit bad ones, as inbound labels already are.
items.doneWhen: A commit with a bad signature is dropped and audited; a good one becomes a label as before.

items.title: IMAP adapter against a real server in CI
items.description: The IMAP channel adapter is exercised only through a mocked fetcher (B-2303); run it against a containerised IMAP server in CI.
items.doneWhen: A message delivered to the test mailbox becomes a channel thread in CI.

items.title: Held values on public forms are queued, not refused
items.description: A public form value the user-input guardrail would hold is refused today (B-2205); queue it as a held submission for review like posts.
items.doneWhen: A held submission appears in the moderation queue and is accepted into a record from there.

items.title: Release 1.6.0
items.description: Version, CHANGELOG, docs and known-gaps sections for 1.6.0.
